sources.title: Film in Moldova (National Center of Cinematography): Cash Rebate
sources.said: Are registered in the Republic of Moldova. … Have a collaboration contract with a foreign producer. … Have a minimum 3 years of production experience. … 25% - of the total eligible expenses incurred on the territory of the Republic of Moldova … + 5% - conditioned by a thematic promotion, within the film, of the geographical area, locality or the entire Republic of Moldova. … TV series (one episode) 15 000 euro … Cartoon series 100 000 euro

figures.finding: Only for a production with a foreign partner: a purely Moldovan series doesn't qualify. No cap is stated on the page.

value.needs: a Moldovan-registered producer with 3 years' experience, a cooperation contract with a foreign producer, the cultural test; filed 25 working days before production
